name: Non-linear Symmetric Equation
description: Replaces the explicit "different phases" conflict rule with an algebraic resonance condition $p_u^{p_v} + p_v^{p_u} = 3$. Since the variables are strictly 1 or 2, this equation forces exactly one variable to be 1 and the other to be 2, preserving the bipartite structure while obfuscating it behind non-linear arithmetic. I expect this to defeat the survivors because it doesn't use graph terminology or logical operators, forcing them to logically evaluate the algebraic equation over the restricted domain rather than pattern-matching a known graph algorithm.
